in_marathi.name: Nivas
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Residence, Abode, Dwelling
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nivas हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Nivas means 'residence', 'abode', or 'dwelling'. It is derived from the root 'niv' which means 'to rest' or 'to remain'. In Hindu mythology, Nivas is the name of various gods and goddesses who provide shelter and protection. The name symbolizes stability, security, and a sense of belonging.
